title: Hindi Releases October 19-25: Gajab Raat on Netflix, Five Films in Theatres
excerpt: Manoj Bajpayee's one-night Netflix thriller Gajab Raat premieres October 23, the same day Udta Teer, Tu Hai Meri Kiran, Kaali Kheti and two romances open in theatres.
body:
• The Hindi slate for October 19-25, 2026 is concentrated on Friday, October 23: one Netflix premiere and five theatrical releases, per Pinkvilla's October list.
  • Gajab Raat, a one-night Netflix thriller starring Manoj Bajpayee and created by Neeraj Pandey, premieres October 23 — the week's only confirmed Hindi streaming premiere.
  • In theatres October 23: Udta Teer (Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan), Tu Hai Meri Kiran (Sonakshi Sinha, Zaheer Iqbal), Kaali Kheti (Jackie Shroff, Sharad Kelkar), Main Na Raha Mera and Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar.
  • Diaspora viewers: Gajab Raat streams on Netflix from October 23; the five theatrical titles are listed for theatres, with no US streaming dates in the sources.

Hindi releases bunch up this week. Cross-checking Pinkvilla's October release list against Netflix's own announcement coverage, the October 19-25 window has one streaming premiere and five Hindi films opening in theatres, all landing on Friday, October 23. Here is each title with its platform, date and cast, as listed by the sources.

Gajab Raat — Netflix, October 23

The week's streaming headline is a suspense thriller set over a single night in Delhi. Manoj Bajpayee plays Ajay Dikshit, a street-smart police officer whose plans for a profitable night unravel when a severely injured young woman is thrown from a moving car. The film is created by Neeraj Pandey, produced by his Friday Film Works and directed by Ritesh Shah in his directorial debut, reuniting Bajpayee and Pandey after nearly a decade. Saqib Saleem, Nushrratt Bharuccha, Divya Dutta, Kiku Sharda, Akshay Oberoi and Shraddha Das co-star. BizAsia quotes Pandey: the tension comes "as much from the moral dilemmas the characters face as from the events unfolding over the course of one night." It premieres on Netflix on October 23.

Udta Teer — theatres, October 23

Ayushmann Khurrana leads this comedy drama as Bilal, an officer who infiltrates India on a covert task, loses his memory in an accident and wakes believing he is an Indian officer — and is then recruited by Indian agencies against his own handlers. Sara Ali Khan, Brijendra Kala, Gulshan Grover, Rahul Bose and Ram Kapoor co-star, per Pinkvilla.

Tu Hai Meri Kiran — theatres, October 23

Sonakshi Sinha plays Kiran, a confident, free-spirited woman whose connection with Samar, played by Zaheer Iqbal, turns into an all-consuming obsession in this supernatural romantic thriller. Pinkvilla lists it among the October 23 theatrical releases.

Kaali Kheti — theatres, October 23

A horror thriller set against a rustic backdrop, examining agriculture through a supernatural framework. The cast is Jackie Shroff, Sharad Kelkar, Neha Sargam, Virendra Saxena and Shaji Chaudhary.

Main Na Raha Mera and Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar — theatres, October 23

Two romances round out the Friday. Main Na Raha Mera stars Adhyayan Suman and Divita Rai as Raj and Simran, who reunite at her wedding twelve years after unrequited love separated them. Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar is a romantic comedy about six school friends reuniting ten years after graduation, starring Alisha Chopra, Sparsh Walia, Sakshi Vaidya, Kunal Vaid and Sargun Kaur Luthra.

How to choose

One night, two clear paths: streamers get a single, star-led thriller at home on Netflix from October 23, while theatre-goers get the week's full spread the same day — comedy, horror, supernatural romance and two love stories. No source listed a US theatrical or streaming date beyond the Netflix premiere, so diaspora readers outside India should check local listings for the five theatrical titles.
